construction: Defined in tools/corpus/make_toy_instances.m and written by MOSEK (mosekopt write, JTASK) from prob.a, c, blc, buc, blx, bux, f, g, accs; read back by mosekopt read, bit-for-bit equal to the written arrays.
derivation: Dual power cone of dimension 3 with exponents (1, 1), normalised to alpha = (1/2, 1/2), on (x0, x1, x2): (x0 / alpha1)^alpha1 (x1 / alpha2)^alpha2 >= |x2|, i.e. 2 sqrt(x0 x1) >= |x2|, x0, x1 >= 0. With x1 = 1 and x2 = 4 fixed, 2 sqrt(x0) >= 4, so x0 >= 4; the minimum 4 is unique; objective 4.
